rca of the issue: Iteration 86 found two related bugs: (1) backend 404'd when a sales row referenced a synthetic customer_id (cust_<hash>) that had never been promoted into customer_accounts; (2) when the frontend ActivityFeed got that 404 with responseType:'blob', e.response.data was a Blob whose .detail was undefined, and the subsequent URL.createObjectURL/a.click code path threw, which propagated into React's render and triggered the runtime error overlay. Iteration 87 fix verified: backend falls back to a sales-aggregator profile (source='sales_aggregator') so the legitimate case now returns 200; even if a 404 happens, downloadProfile decodes the Blob body to extract detail and wraps the finalize step in try/catch so nothing escapes to React. Verified end-to-end with curl + Playwright.
